# damilareoo-portfolio

> Damilare Osofisan is a Software Designer in Lagos, Nigeria, designing
> and building 0–1 products across web, mobile, brand, and visual systems.

## Who

- Name: Damilare Osofisan (handle: damilareoo, everywhere)
- Title: Software Designer (also described as Product Designer)
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria
- Contact: dosofisan7@gmail.com, https://x.com/damilareoo,
  https://www.linkedin.com/in/damilareoo, https://www.are.na/damilare-osofisan

## Selected work

- Hitman's Library (2026, in progress) — a visual library collecting
  the web's best experiences. Product, design, and code with
  Florence Eze. https://hitmanslibrary.xyz/
- Endgame (2026) — Product Designer at endgame.ai. Restructured the
  live product, brought web to mobile parity, designed Puzzle Run,
  Club, Watch, Coach, Learn, gamification, piece sets, and avatars.
  https://endgame.ai
- ChessEver (2025) — Founding Designer. Live chess tournaments across
  iOS, Android, desktop, and web. 5.0 on the App Store, 4.8 on Google
  Play, 1,000+ weekly active users. https://chessever.com
- Sylvan (2025) — Brand, logo, web design, and visual system for a
  revenue intelligence platform. https://sylvanlabs.com
- HEX — Design Partner across web, brand, and product. https://hex.inc

## Capabilities

Product design, UX, interaction design, UI, design systems, brand
design, logo design, web design, visual direction, design engineering
(Next.js), user research, prototyping.
